site.name: Segue
site.tagline: Your chart, your set, your cue.

app.requirements: a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later

analytics.name: TelemetryDeck
analytics.location: the European Union (Germany and the Netherlands), with Amazon Web Services, a U.S. company, among its hosting providers
analytics.transferBasis: Standard Contractual Clauses for any transfer to its U.S. hosting provider
analytics.retention: TelemetryDeck has no fixed deletion date for statistics; they may be kept in its archive for up to 10 years
analytics.source: Checked 2026-10-17. telemetrydeck.com/docs/guides/privacy-faq/: servers on Microsoft Azure (Amsterdam), AWS (Frankfurt) and Hetzner (Falkenstein and Nuremberg). telemetrydeck.com/privacy/: hosting providers Microsoft Ireland Operations Ltd., Amazon Web Services, Inc. (Seattle, USA) and Hetzner Online GmbH; third-country transfers only under GDPR Art. 44 ff., e.g. Standard Contractual Clauses. telemetrydeck.com/dpa/ and /avv/ list no subprocessors.

board.name: Featurebase
board.transferBasis: Standard Contractual Clauses for any transfer outside the EU
board.retention: until you delete them or ask us to

hosting.name: Cloudflare (Cloudflare Pages)
hosting.location: United States and Cloudflare's global network
hosting.transferBasis: the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses

webAnalytics.name: Cloudflare Web Analytics
webAnalytics.location: United States and Cloudflare's global network
webAnalytics.transferBasis: the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses

modelDownload.name: Hugging Face
modelDownload.location: United States, through its download network (cdn.hf.co)
modelDownload.retention: Hugging Face's own retention, under its privacy policy; we receive nothing from it
modelDownload.source: Checked 2026-10-20. huggingface.co/privacy (effective 2023-03-28) section 6: 'The Company and its servers are located in the United States.' A /resolve/<revision>/model.safetensors request answers 302 to us.aws.cdn.hf.co.

inbox.name: Google (Gmail)
inbox.retention: as long as needed to answer you, and at most 2 years
